title: Nokware Hwehwɛfo a Wɔada
intro: Fa w’adwene bu bere bi a wɔkasa tiaa gyidi, na akra kuw bi paw gyidi a enhinhim sen wiase awerɛkyekye. Esiane sɛ na wohyia ɔkwan a ɛyɛ hu a wɔbɛpaw nti, wɔhwehwɛɛ guankɔbea, na wofii akwantu bi a ɛde nna soronko bi ase. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ ɔsoro ahobanbɔ ne tumi a gyidie wɔ tia nhyɛsoɔ. So wubetumi ahu nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ nwonwa yi yɛ?
clues: Ná yɛyɛ nhyiam ketewaa bi, na Ɔbɔadeɛ Baako no mu gyidi a emu dɔ na ɛka bom.
Yɛtenaa berɛ bi a sodifoɔ bi a ɔwɔ tumi hwehwɛ sɛ wɔsom obi foforɔ a ɛnyɛ Allah.
Nea ɛbɛyɛ na yɛakora yɛn gyidi so no, yesii gyinae sɛ yebegyaw yɛn afie hɔ aguan nhyɛso no.
Ɔhokafo nokwafo bi, asase so abɔde bi kaa yɛn ho wɔ yɛn akwantu no mu.
Yenyaa kronkronbea wo bea bi a atew ne ho, faako a Allah maa yekoo nna a emu ye den na ekyerekyeree mu.
Bere a yɛsɔree no, na yegye di sɛ da koro anaa da no fã bi pɛ na atwam, nanso mfehaha pii atwam ampa.

verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
